import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton'].copy()
anom = a[a.date==pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')]
base = a[(a.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-09-01'))&(a.date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-19'))]
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    g = base.groupby([col,'date']).unblended_cost.sum().groupby(col).mean().rename('base_avg')
    ga = anom.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum().rename('anom')
    cmp = pd.concat([g,ga],axis=1).fillna(0)
    cmp['diff']=cmp.anom-cmp.base_avg
    print(col); print(cmp.sort_values('diff',ascending=False)); print()

import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.width',250); pd.set_option('display.max_rows',300)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton'].copy()

# per-row z-scores for the week before vs anomaly day
recent = a[(a.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13'))&(a.date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-19'))]
anom = a[a.date==pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')]
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price']
m = recent.groupby(key).unblended_cost.agg(['mean','std','count']).reset_index()
j = anom.merge(m, on=key, how='left')
j['z'] = (j.unblended_cost - j['mean'])/(j['std'].replace(0,float('nan')))
print(j.sort_values('diff' if False else 'unblended_cost', ascending=False).head(15)[key+['unblended_cost','mean','std','z']].to_string())
